summary: End-to-end testing of the new /admin secure dashboard. All 19 backend pytest cases pass (login success/fail/case-insensitive, /admin/me with valid/missing/invalid/malformed Bearer, /admin/metrics shape + auth gate, /admin/signups list/search/pagination + auth gate, public endpoints still open, admin seed idempotency via repeat-login). Full Playwright flow on the live preview URL also passes: login form renders -> wrong password shows 'Invalid email or password' -> correct credentials store token in localStorage['admin_token'] (len=196) and navigate to /admin/dashboard -> all 10 dashboard testids visible (metric-total-signups, metric-revenue, metric-founding, metric-mythos, admin-category-breakdown, admin-source-breakdown, admin-signup-table-panel, admin-signup-search, admin-refresh-button, admin-logout-button) -> debounced search works -> prev pagination disabled on page 1 -> refresh re-fetches without error -> logout clears token and redirects to /admin -> visiting /admin/dashboard with no token cleanly redirects to login (no black screen) -> visiting with garbage token triggers axios 401 interceptor that clears token and redirects to /admin. No console errors aside from the expected 401s. Obsidian + neon-cyan aesthetic is intact (cyber-grid bg, neon-bordered panels, JetBrains Mono).
action_items: No new action items for the admin dashboard. The previously reported /api/checkout/status 500 (iteration_1) has been mitigated in server.py with a try/except that falls back to the persisted db.payment_transactions record - retest that flow if checkout regression is needed.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin auth uses bcrypt for password storage and HS256 JWT (24h TTL) - solid baseline. JWT_SECRET, ADMIN_EMAIL, ADMIN_PASSWORD all read from env, not hardcoded.
seed_admin() is idempotent and also rotates the hash when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes - good.
MongoDB _id and password_hash are correctly stripped from /admin/me response.
All admin endpoints (except /login) are gated by get_current_admin() which checks token validity, role, and admin existence.
Frontend axios interceptor on adminApi cleanly clears localStorage and redirects on 401 - verified end-to-end.

Note: CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per CORS spec but FastAPI/Starlette tolerates it; consider tightening to the explicit preview origin for production hardening.
Note: There is no brute-force lockout on /api/admin/login (playbook calls for 5-fail lockout). Not blocking - admin password is strong - but worth adding rate limiting for prod.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login error, login success, dashboard render, search, pagination, refresh, logout, redirect-without-token, 401-interceptor all verified)

seed_data_creation: Created two TEST_-prefixed waitlist entries during the run (TEST_admin_* and TEST_pub_*) via the public /api/waitlist endpoint. Non-destructive and idempotent on re-run. Also touched db.admins via seed on startup - already idempotent in server.py.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_admin.py - 19 tests, ~2.7s runtime. Login is case-insensitive on email. /admin/me strips _id and password_hash. Token TTL is 24h (expires_in=86400). Frontend stores token in localStorage['admin_token']; 401 interceptor in /app/frontend/src/lib/adminApi.js clears it and redirects to /admin. The previously reported 'black screen' at /admin was a transient HMR error and is no longer reproducible - confirmed both with-token-cleared and with-garbage-token paths land on the login form, not a blank page.
rca of the issue: N/A - no new bugs found this iteration. Black-screen report from main agent was investigated and confirmed resolved (caused by transient webpack HMR compile during the previous edit window; rebuild is now clean and all admin routes render correctly).
